legacy.claim: A conventionally coupled subluminal gravitational mode is tightly constrained by gravitational Cherenkov losses
legacy.evidence: Previously conjecture pending a local study note; supported 2026-08-28 by [moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § gravitational Cherenkov: Moore & Nelson 2001 give \(c-c_g<2\times10^{-15}c\) for Galactic cosmic-ray origins and ~\(2\times10^{-19}c\) for extragalactic; scope is a conventionally coupled mode. The Branch C potential is exactly such a mode, so the bound pins its speed parameter ([Branch C](branch-c.md) § Walls; the scalar-mode extension of the graviton scaling is flagged there as conjecture)
